summary: The retrieved content represents a JavaScript library for creating and handling popup calendars on a webpage. It provides mechanisms for displaying calendars in various formats, setting specific dates or ranges as unselectable, and customizing the appearance and behavior of the calendar through CSS and JavaScript functions.
purpose: This library is used to add interactive calendar functionality to web applications. It allows users to select dates and provides configurations for different calendar displays, like months, quarters, and years, as well as support for international date formatting.

workflows.name: Display Calendar
steps: Set display type (e.g., date, month, year)
Configure appearance and behavior via settings (e.g., CSS prefix, disabled dates)

workflows.name: Select Date
steps: User clicks on a calendar element
Return selected date in specified format

business_rules: Supports multiple date formats for internationalization
Calendar can be displayed as a DIV or separate window
Anchor tags must have both NAME and ID attributes
validations: Check if input object is a valid form input
conditions: If display_month < 1, adjust year and month accordingly
system_behavior: Popup calendars can auto-hide when clicks occur outside them
Dropdowns for month and year navigation are optional
exceptions: Error alert for invalid form input
